project_status.summary: The ai-office framework is fully operational. 16 specialized agents run as Claude CLI subprocesses. Features: project workspaces, structured decisions memory, self-evaluation loop (re-runs if score <7), peer review (toggleable), OpenAI web search via MCP (orange indicator in dashboard), phased execution (Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3), token tracking, stuck-task recovery on server restart.

active_decisions: All agent memory lives in projects/{slug}/memory/decisions/{category}.md — five categories: architecture, implementation, compliance, brand, strategy
Agents self-score output 1-10; server retries up to 2x if score <7
Peer review is togglable via dashboard — arve reviewed by odd, bjorn by arve, dag by arve, jorunn by ingrid, ingrid by jorunn, else by halvard, halvard by else
Web search agents (else, halvard, guro, laila, knut, nora, frode, jorunn, magnus) use OpenAI gpt-4o-search-preview via MCP — shown with orange indicator in dashboard
Phased execution: Phase 1 (bjorn, dag, magnus) → Phase 2 (arve, ingrid, jorunn, else, frode) → Phase 3 (odd, per)
Task files use YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md in projects/{slug}/tasks/{bucket}/
All deliverables go to output/{slug}/{category}/ — output/ and projects/ are gitignored
mcp_search.json is regenerated at server startup with real OPENAI_API_KEY baked in — never commit it
Stuck tasks (in active/ on startup) are moved back to backlog automatically by _recover_stuck_tasks()
Magnus labels findings: LAUNCH BLOCKER / HIGH RISK / ADVISORY — arve must implement all LAUNCH BLOCKER items

recent_updates.note: core/ module extracted. Project workspaces added.

Self-evaluation loop: agents score 1-10, server retries up to 2x if below 7. Peer review system added with per-agent assignments.
Peer review toggle button added to dashboard (Review: ON/OFF). Token tracking added to dashboard (SQLite). Memory tab added to output panel.
OpenAI web search via MCP integrated. Web search agents pass --mcp-config to claude CLI. mcp_search.json written at startup with real API key.
Orange indicator added to dashboard for agents using OpenAI web search (dashed ring on canvas sprite, orange text in output). Fixed MCP key substitution bug.
Stuck-task recovery added: _recover_stuck_tasks() moves active/ tasks to backlog on server restart. output/ and projects/ added to .gitignore.
Stale file audit: CLAUDE.md rewritten, all 16 agent .md files updated, backend/ and frontend/ deleted, core/projects.py and cli/office.py updated, team memory brought current.
